;Arts and culture
*[[Eurovision Song Contest 2019]]
**[[Duncan Laurence]], representing the [[Netherlands]], wins the 2019 edition of the [[Eurovision Song Contest]] with the song "[[Arcade (song)|Arcade]]". It is the country's first win since {{escyr|1975}}. [https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio/2019/may/19/eurovision-song-contest-2019-won-by-the-netherlands-duncan-laurence (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*Five foreign tourists, four of whom were Americans, are killed when their [[Piper PA-32]] crashes into the [[Atlantic Ocean]] near [[Honduras]] shortly after taking off from [[Roatán]] island. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/americans-die-small-plane-crash-honduras/story?id=63138739 (ABC News)]

;Health and environment 
*[[2019 Cook Islands dengue fever outbreak]]
**The [[Cook Islands]] secretary of health, [[Josephine Herman]], says that the country is holding and containing the latest outbreak of Dengue, which has killed 22 people and infected another 28. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/389509/cooks-health-secretary-says-dengue-total-up-to-50l (Radio New Zealand)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Alabama]]
**One person was killed and eight injured in a shooting after a dispute between two women at a large high school graduation party. The suspect is still at large. [https://www.abc12.com/content/news/1-dead-8-shot-at-high-school-graduation-party-in-Alabama-510154361.html (Associated Press)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Argentine general election]]
**Former [[President of Argentina|Argentine President]] [[Cristina Fernández de Kirchner]] announces that she will run for [[Vice President of Argentina|Vice President]] in the 2019 Argentine general election, with former [[Chief of the Cabinet of Ministers|Chief of Staff]] [[Alberto Fernández]] as her running mate for President. [http://www.telam.com.ar/notas/201905/359235-alberto-fernandez-presidente-cristina-vice-cfk-formula-kirchnerismo-elecciones.html (''Télam'')] [https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/alberto-fernandez-presidente-cristina-kirchner-vice-video-nid2249202 (''La Nación'')]
*[[2019 Australian federal election]]
**Voters in [[Australia]] go to the polls to elect new members of the [[Australian House of Representatives|House of Representatives]] and half of the [[Australian Senate|Senate]]. [https://www.sbs.com.au/news/vote-2019-australians-head-to-the-polls-in-tight-federal-election (SBS)] 
**Prime Minister [[Scott Morrison]] declares victory. It remains unclear whether his [[Liberal Party of Australia|Liberal]]-[[National Party of Australia|National]] [[Coalition (Australia)|Coalition]] has won a majority of seats, or whether it will form a [[minority government]]. [https://www.smh.com.au/federal-election-2019/coalition-backs-morrison-to-stay-liberal-leader-regardless-of-election-outcome-20190518-p51opw.html (''Sydney Morning Herald'')]
**Despite [[Opinion polling for the 2019 Australian federal election|opinion polls]] predicting a Labor victory, the [[Australian Labor Party|Labor Party]] loses several seats, with support in the key state of [[Queensland]] far lower than expected. Opposition Leader [[Bill Shorten]] concedes defeat and steps down as party leader. [https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/6131296/shorten-stands-down-as-labor-leader/?cs=14231 (''Canberra Times'')]
**Former Prime Minister [[Tony Abbott]] loses [[Division of Warringah|his seat]] to independent candidate and former Olympian [[Zali Steggall]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/global/2019/may/18/australian-election-tony-abbott-loses-his-warringah-seat-to-zali-steggall (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Efforts to impeach Donald Trump]]
**[[Justin Amash]] from [[Michigan's 3rd congressional district]] becomes the first [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] to support the [[Impeachment in the United States|impeachment]] of [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/lawmaker-breaking-with-gop-accuses-trump-of-obstruction-impeachable-conduct (Fox News)]
*[[Ibiza affair]]
**[[Vice-Chancellor of Austria]], [[Heinz-Christian Strache]], steps down both as Vice-Chancellor and chairman of the [[Freedom Party of Austria]] due to an alleged corruption scandal. [https://www.dw.com/en/austrian-vice-chancellor-heinz-christian-strache-resigns-following-alleged-corruption-scandal/a-48783968 (DW)]
**[[Sebastian Kurz]], [[Chancellor of Austria]], announces the dissolution of his [[First Kurz government|government]] and calls for a [[2019 Austrian legislative election|snap election]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/austria-election-kurz-heinz-christian-strache-corruption-scandal-resignation-video-a8920216.html (''Independent'')]

;Sports
*[[2019 FA Cup Final]], [[2018–19 Manchester City F.C. season]]
**[[Manchester City F.C.]] win England's [[2018–19 FA Cup]] by defeating [[Watford F.C.]] 6-0 in [[2019 FA Cup Final|the final]], marking the first time that an English club has won [[Treble (association football)#Domestic trebles|all three domestic titles in one season]]. [http://www.thefa.com/news/2019/may/18/fa-cup-final-man-city-watford-180519 (England's Football Association)]
